standard.experience: 3+ years in the industry including 1+ year designing and managing Google Cloud solutions; recommended experience, not a formal prerequisite.

renewal.eligibility: Active holders within the applicable renewal window. Designated Google Skills renewal courses or badges are a separate official option with their own eligibility and validity rules.

items.title: Start with the standard exam blueprint
items.use: Use the numbered objectives to find gaps; this site keeps the standard weights as its default.
items.caution: The renewal guide has different emphasis. Do not mix its percentages into a first-exam study plan.

items.title: Confirm exam logistics and eligibility
items.use: Check format, language, fees, recommended experience and current registration or renewal rules.
items.caution: Fees shown here are USD before applicable taxes; confirm the official registration terms.

items.title: Follow the Google Skills preparation path
items.access: Account required for participation; lab access may require credits or a subscription
items.use: Use courses, labs and skill badges as the hands-on companion to these written chapters.
items.caution: The public path lists 13 activities when checked. Their availability and access terms can change.

items.title: Use the partner path when eligible
items.use: The supplied partner URL resolves to the Professional Data Engineer path on Google Skills for Partners.
items.caution: The public page lists 15 activities when checked; membership and entitlement are separate from exam eligibility.

items.title: Read reference architectures after learning the services
items.use: Compare end-to-end patterns against business requirements and failure modes.
items.caution: This is a collection, not the numbered exam blueprint.

items.title: Review cross-service tradeoffs
items.use: Review security, reliability, operation, performance and cost decisions together.
items.caution: Use the framework as design guidance; the standard exam guide determines study scope.

items.title: Optional Google Cloud preparation on Coursera
items.access: Provider enrolment; review current course and lab terms
items.use: The provider page identifies the Google Cloud preparation program for the Cloud Data Engineer certification.
items.caution: A course-completion certificate is separate from passing the Professional Data Engineer certification exam.

items.title: Optional personal notes on GitHub
items.use: Use another learner’s organization of topics as a secondary reading aid.
items.caution: The repository references an older preparation account and delivery information. Verify exam logistics and technical claims with current official sources; its notes are not incorporated as authoritative answer keys.

plan.title: 1. Map the requirements
plan.outcome: Explain identity, location, privacy, transfer and recovery constraints before naming a product.

plan.title: 2. Make warehouse data trustworthy
plan.outcome: Predict row grain, duplicates, null rules and current-state behavior under a rerun.

plan.title: 3. Follow the stream
plan.outcome: Describe delivery, event time, retention, triggers, sink corrections and replacement separately.

plan.title: 4. Govern and share the platform
plan.outcome: Choose a supported access path and explain ownership, quality, cost and consumer expectations.

plan.title: 5. Evaluate the analytical result
plan.outcome: Measure freshness and usefulness; distinguish retrieval, generation and model evaluation evidence.

plan.title: 6. Operate and rehearse recovery
plan.outcome: Use stage-level diagnostics, repeatable operations and a failure-specific recovery runbook.

verificationNotes: The supplied Skills Boost URLs redirect to Google Skills and Google Skills for Partners.
The supplied Architecture Framework URL now uses Well-Architected Framework naming.
The standard and renewal PDFs are valid separate guides with different weights.
No specific GitHub fact-sheet URL or Udemy course was supplied. This site provides its own referenced field guide and labels the verified optional community repository as secondary reading.
Availability checking validates a URL response, not every claim in every external course or personal note.
The 349 imported answer keys retain their prior review status. Expanded learning material does not turn an unreviewed third-party key into an official answer.
